events.text: A wandering monk walks the same road. He has walked it, he says, for forty years.

effects.log: He talks little. You learn much.
He blesses your road.

events.text: A market town you have never visited, on market day.

effects.log: Strange fruits, strange people, a good day.
A day of carrying. (+5 taels)

events.text: A nine-storey pagoda on a hill, its bells ringing in the wind.

effects.log: Nine storeys, nine breaths, one view.
Eighty-one bells. You count twice.

events.text: Two stone lions guard a ruined gate. Legend says they come alive at night.

effects.log: Nothing happens. You feel very safe.
For luck. Everyone does.

events.text: A mountain stream so clear you can count the pebbles.

effects.log: The coldest, sweetest water.
The water pushes; you learn to root.

events.text: A herdsman on a hillside plays a flute to his goats.

effects.log: The goats and you enjoy it equally.
The goats flee.

events.text: An old battlefield where villagers say the dead still march at night.

effects.log: Only mist and the wind. You sleep poorly.
The villagers are grateful someone did.

events.text: A temple burned in a war long ago. A single statue still stands.

effects.log: Calm, like the statue.
A day of work. The statue looks less lonely.

events.text: Thousands of cranes rise from the marsh at once.

effects.log: You understand something about lightness.
Your sketch is terrible. The memory is not.

events.text: A ferry pulled across the river on a rope. The ferryman is asleep.

effects.log: Hard work. You leave a coin.
He is grumpy but kind.

events.text: A high pass where the snow never melts.

ok.log: Cold, thin air, and a view of two provinces.

fail.log: Frostbite on two fingers. They recover.

choices.text: Wait for a caravan to cross with

effects.log: Safer together.

events.text: A village built entirely of bamboo, even the cups.

effects.log: Everything creaks. You sleep well.
A basket, slightly lopsided.

variants: A village made entirely of bamboo, down to the cups and spoons.

events.text: A spring where people throw coins for luck.

effects.log: Who knows.

choices.text: Fish out coins for the poor

effects.log: A handful of copper for a beggar.

events.text: Terraced tea hills, with pickers singing as they work.

effects.log: Green fingers and a free bag of tea.
A tin of the finest. (−3 taels)

events.text: The ruins of a library. Most books are dust. Some are not.

ok.log: A martial treatise, only slightly eaten by mice.

choices.text: Take the surviving books to a scholar

effects.log: He weeps with joy.

events.text: Steps carved into a cliff lead to a cave with a closed stone door.

ok.log: Inside: an empty meditation cave, perfect for training.

fail.log: It does not move. Your shoulder aches.

effects.log: The cliff wind is its own teacher.

variants: Steps cut into the cliff face climb to a cave sealed by a stone door.

events.text: A valley full of wildflowers, humming with bees.

effects.log: The best nap of the year.
The girls and grannies love you.

events.text: An old man sits on a bridge and asks a riddle of all who pass.

ok.log: He laughs and gives you a peach.

fail.log: Wrong. He laughs anyway and lets you pass.

effects.log: He cannot answer. He is delighted.

variants: An old man sits in the middle of a bridge and has a riddle for everyone who wants to cross.

events.text: An abandoned farm with a well, an orchard, and no people.

effects.log: Apples, sour and good.
Someone may come back.

events.text: Hundreds of lanterns float down the river at night for the dead.

choices.text: Float one for someone you lost

effects.log: It drifts away, glowing.
The river full of lights.

events.text: A circle of standing stones on a high moor.

effects.log: Your qi hums strangely.
Nine stones. Always nine, however many times you count.

events.text: A cave that breathes cold air in and out, like a sleeping giant.

effects.log: A long tunnel, ending in a glittering chamber.

choices.text: Sit at the mouth and breathe with it

effects.log: Your breath and the mountain's.

events.text: A tomb where a swordsman is buried with his swords.

effects.log: The wind hums through the swords.
His final form, carved on the stone.

events.text: A village fair: strongmen, jugglers and a pig race.

effects.log: You lift the stone. A ribbon.
Chaos. Joy.

events.text: A bridge where lovers tie ribbons for luck.

effects.log: For someone, someday.
Thousands of hopes.
